newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Two seriously injured in HK truck explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two seriously injured in HK truck explosion.

text.p: Drivers and pedestrians fled for their lives on Monday when a truckload of motorcycles exploded during rush hour, sending a fireball across a busy Hong Kong highway and knocking out windows in nearby flats.
The explosion aboard the container truck, which was carrying 160 motorcycles, damaged another seven vehicles and blanketed the street with thick, greasy smoke, witnesses said.

Two male motorists in their 30s were seriously injured and a two-year-old boy living on the seventh floor of a nearby block of flats was slightly hurt by debris when the blast shattered the windows, Hong Kong radio reported.
Police said they were amazed that the inferno and resulting traffic pile-up claimed no lives. They did not provide further details.
Earlier reports erroneously said a tanker truck loaded with petrol had exploded after being set off by a blast aboard the container truck.

Firefighters told Hong Kong radio the driver of the truck had seen smoke coming from the container shortly before a large explosion and several smaller ones scattered twisted metal and shredded rubber tyres across the road.
Police said they were conducting forensic tests to determine the cause of the explosion.
